name: runyth-illuminated-documents
description: Source repository and deterministic packaging for the Illuminated Documents Foundry VTT module.

scripts.clean: node -e "Promise.all(['build','dist'].map(async (name) => { const fs = await import('node:fs/promises'); await fs.rm(name, { recursive: true, force: true }); await fs.mkdir(name); await fs.writeFile(name + '/.gitkeep', ''); }))"
scripts.package: npm run build && node tools/package.mjs && node tools/verify-package.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run package
